title: a page saved from the fetch list names the steps it was saved for
line: the list gives the save script a call whose key is the steps the page serves; the script writes the key as a second comment under the saved-from line; collect reaches the steps the key names first, the inference from the page's own identity left out of it: after the plan rewrote the step's fields the search's name no longer reads as the citation's, and the page reaches the step all the same; a Find a Grave memorial saved from the list is reached by its key too

steps.say: the list's call for her Kentucky death records search: the file name, no force at a holder the script knows, and the step's own id as the key

expect.why: the key is the plan step ids the page serves, here the one step

steps.say: the search saved from the list: the script's page, the key under its saved-from line
before the page is collected the plan writes new fields on the step: the name the citation sits on is now the married name, so the search's name (Bell) is no longer the citation's
collect: the page reaches the step its key names, not by the name or the collection

steps.has: page's own key names this step

expect.why: the key's one step, with the key as its reason and nothing else reached: the inference by name finds no step now, and the page needed none
the step's log row carries the page as its artifact: no candidate fits her, so the run is none

steps.say: a memorial saved from the list: its call and key, as for any page the script knows

expect.why: the entry for the memorial names its one step

steps.say: collect: the memorial's step by the key; the memorial the citation's URL names is the page's own, so nothing contradicts it

steps.has: page's own key names this step

expect.why: the key's step stands and leads; the step the citation's memorial URL reaches is the same step, taken once
